title: Family Picnic Baseball Game, 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo
back_text_transcription:
Sharon, Bert, Rod, Art, Rae, Pat, Danny, Cary + Steve
Family picnic - Baseball game
July 25, 1954
description: A 1954 black and white snapshot depicting a family gathering and casual baseball game in a spacious grassy yard beside a rustic barn. Children and family members (identified on the reverse as Sharon, Bert, Rod, Art, Rae, Pat, Danny, Cary, and Steve) are scattered across the field enjoying mid-century summer recreation.
